detail.longDescription: I have this API which should get one item_1 with (connected table to) item_2.id and item_2.title . @app.get("/placeholder/{item_id}", status_code=200) def get_one_item(*, session: Session = Depends(get_session), item_id: UUID): """This function (api) gets one specific item_id.""" specific_item = session.exec( select(Item, Item_2) .where(Item.item_id == item_id) .where(Item.item_2_id == Item_2.item_2_id) ).first() if not specific_item : raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Deze item bestaat niet.") return specific_item When I test this API in FastAPI-Swagger UI, I get the following error: ValueError: [ValueError('dictionary update sequence element #0 has length 18; 2 is required'), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')] I have another API which was returning all items, had the same issue like this but since it was returning .all() instead of .first() fixed it by adding this: return [ { "item": vars(item), "item_2": {"id": item_2.id,"title": item_2_title}, } for (item, item_2) in items ] This code makes nested dictionary in list where I can access item and item_2 details that I have specified. How would I make sure that I can get same results without for loop in get_one_item function?
